basic_info.description: Welcome to 2974-2976 26th Street, a beautifully maintained duplex in San Francisco's vibrant Mission District. This charming two-unit building offers a fantastic opportunity for owner-occupiers or investors, with the upper unit delivered vacant. The upper flat features two spacious bedrooms, a bright living/dining area, in-unit laundry, and elegant hardwood floors, all bathed in natural light. Enjoy views of Bernal Hill and peekaboo glimpses of Salesforce Tower.    There is a bonus room also delivered vacant with a full bath on the lower level provides flexibility for a home office, guest space, or rental income. The expansive, manicured yard offers a serene retreat, perfect for entertaining.    Additional highlights include a large two-car garage with an EV charger and major recent upgrades: a new furnace, ductwork, roof membrane, and two new water heaters.    Located in the sought-after Mission District, this property is near top dining, shopping, nightlife, public transit, tech shuttles, and freeway accessmaking commuting a breeze.
